description: the NAMESPACE half of CHANGE_NOTIFY -- entries appearing, being renamed and disappearing, watched through the two name filters and nothing else. The subset the model and Samba agree on, so it is driven record-for-record to the end of a 400-message trace where the full stepNotify flavour above stops at SD-10 / SD-11 within a few dozen steps. No deviation of this smbd is reachable from this flavour, so the cell states the standard exactly and is its own strict twin -- and it GATES, rather than reporting.
